name: Ankh Do: To-Do List & Task Timer
description:
Ankh Do is a simple to-do list and task manager that lives in your GNOME top bar. Click the ankh, type a task, press Enter. That's it.

Keep track of what you need to do without opening an app or signing up for anything. Check tasks off as you finish them, and use the built-in task timer to see how long each one takes. The timer keeps running even when the menu is closed, so it works for time tracking too.

Features:
• Quick to-do list: add a task and press Enter, then add the next one
• Checklist: mark tasks done with one click
• Task timer: start and pause a stopwatch on any task
• Drag and drop to reorder tasks and set priorities
• Edit a task in place, copy its text, or delete it, with Undo if you change your mind
• The top bar shows how many tasks are still open
• Clear all completed tasks in one step
• Dark theme and a light off-white theme, chosen in Settings
• Full keyboard shortcuts

Keyboard shortcuts:
Up/Down: move between tasks
Alt+Up/Down: move a task up or down
Space: mark as done
Enter or F2: edit
T: start or pause the timer
C: copy
Delete: delete
Esc: cancel or close

A calm, pharaonic design: gold and papyrus on black basalt, with an ankh in your top bar.

Private by design: your tasks are saved locally and never leave your computer. No account, no internet connection, and no data collection. The clipboard is used only when you copy a task.

Great for daily planning, work tasks, study, shopping lists, and anything you want to get done.
